review:
Fangtastic Freespins is a werewolf collect slot with potions, claws and full-moon money symbols. Three, four or five scatters award 10, 15 or 20 free spins.

During the bonus, the werewolf collects every full-moon money symbol on screen, with prizes up to 5,000x. A blood bank above the reels grows by 1x with every werewolf that lands, building a multiplier across the round. The RTP is 96.51%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish an overall max win. It's essentially the Big Bass formula with a horror twist.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
